title: Computer Use drives Finder to open a .command file via GUI, bypassing Bash hooks
reason_not_testable: No Bash, Read or Grep PostToolUse payload is produced for GUI automation, so no hook can be fed a fixture. Non-hook control: keep Claude Code at or above 2.1.243 (check with claude --version), disable Computer Use for sessions that can see secrets, and keep secret files out of Finder-reachable paths.
